name: Microsoft Cost Management
sku: Microsoft Cost Management and Billing, covering Azure cost. It reports Azure costs across every service, so the scope is the whole spine.

bands.note: A suite of FinOps tools to analyse, monitor and optimise cloud costs: Cost Analysis, budget, anomaly and scheduled alerts, tag inheritance and shared-cost allocation rules, and exports to external systems.

presentation.tagline: Cost analysis, budgets, anomaly alerts and cost allocation for Azure.
